purpose: Three pages, one section per page, forced with \newpage: page count, per-page heading position, top margin on pages 2-3.
flashtex_features: \newpage (support unknown; if ignored the page breaks come from overflow instead)
notes: Each section also has enough text to nearly fill a page so the layout is comparable even where \newpage is ignored.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
